title: Speaking — Unusual lessons
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on unusual lessons.

questions: What is a typical breakfast for you?
When do you usually eat your main meal?
Which meal of the day do you most look forward to?
Do you enjoy eating with several other people?
Which classes did you enjoy most at school?
Do you remember a lesson that took place outside a classroom?

part2.topic: Describe a lesson you remember because the method was unusual.
part2.closing: and explain why the method helped you remember the material.

questions: When can novel classroom activities distract from learning?
How should teachers judge whether a new teaching method works?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to unusual lessons?
